headline: Phillies blow 6-3 lead, swept by Marlins in finale
recap: The Phillies led 6-3 after five innings on Wednesday night in Miami but lost 8-6 to the Marlins, completing a three-game sweep. The Marlins tied it with three runs in the seventh, then took the lead for good with two more in the eighth off reliever Jonathan Bowlan. Griffin Conine and Heriberto Hernandez each homered with two RBIs, and Xavier Edwards added a two-RBI single for Miami. Trea Turner went 2-for-5 with his 15th home run and an RBI for Philadelphia, Bryson Stott drove in two runs on a double, and Bryce Harper tripled in a run.

Starter Jesus Luzardo was charged with all six Marlins runs over 6.1 innings, allowing six hits, three walks and a home run, and Bowlan (2-1) took the loss after surrendering the decisive eighth-inning runs. At 57-52, the Phillies sit second in the NL East, 6.5 games behind Atlanta, and have lost three straight.

Philadelphia is off today. The Phillies open a three-game series at Baltimore on Friday at 7:05 PM ET, with Brandon Young starting for the Orioles; Philadelphia had not named a starter as of this writing. No betting line is posted yet for the matchup.
